rawinputmouse.description: Use raw relative mouse movement while retaining the game’s buttons, wheel, sensitivity and inversion.
plugin.name: Manhunt Fusion Fix
hudaspect.description: Auto uses the whole screen width: the radar at the left edge, status, health, inventory and timer at the right edge. A ratio keeps the HUD in a centered box of that aspect. Menus always keep their 4:3 design.
fmvmode.description: Both choices show every movie whole at its own shape, with black bars where the screen is wider or narrower. Nothing is cut off or stretched.
windowmode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the resolution chosen at startup, or a borderless window covering the monitor. Needs a restart.
confinecursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game's window while the game is in front, so it can't slip onto another monitor. It's let go when you switch to another window or move the window.
fpslimit.description: Caps the frame rate without the game's busy wait. The game itself never runs faster than 200 fps.
fov.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view, up to 150 degrees across. Cutscenes, menus and zoomed views are not changed.
skipintro.description: Skips the startup legal screen wait and the opening logo video. Needs a restart.
textlanguage.description: Language of the fix's own texts. Auto follows the game's language.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
checkupdates.description: Checks for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Settings; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if it is installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Manhunt Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Manhunt Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
borders.description: Keeps the original 4:3 cutscene frame with side borders on wider screens and top and bottom borders on narrower screens. Off removes these borders and fills the screen. The original game has no animated cutscene bars.
pausefocus.description: Pauses while another window is active. Turn off to keep playing in the background in Windowed or Borderless mode. Fullscreen keeps its native pause to protect the exclusive device.
padlayout.description: Modern adds native controller actions and menu navigation while keeping your keyboard and mouse bindings. Left stick moves, right stick looks, RT attacks, LT aims, A uses, B sneaks, X reloads, Y opens inventory, stick clicks run/look back, Back changes view, Start pauses, bumpers peek and D-pad cycles inventory. Original uses saved native bindings.
padicons.description: Controller artwork in Controls, menu hints and supported tutorials. Auto uses Xbox; choose PlayStation or Nintendo for another controller. Tutorial prompts follow the last input device. Your keyboard and mouse bindings stay unchanged.
padcamera.description: Multiplies the native right-stick camera speed with the Modern layout. Does not change mouse sensitivity.
vibration.description: Restores the native attack feedback through Xidi. Each motor follows the original strength and duration in real time. Stops when unfocused or disabled.
